text: 1.High school graduate or above, qualified for university entrance, physically and mentally healthyforeigners (applicants with color weakness and color blindness are not eligible to apply).2.According toNationality Law of the People’s Republic of Chinaand the regulations released by Ministry of Educationof the PRC[Circular No. 12 (2020)], if an applicant was born in a foreign country and one or both of the applicant’s parents hold Chinese citizenship (including Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan), the applicant shall have Chinese citizenship; however, if the applicant’s parents who hold Chinese citizenship (including Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) hadacquired permanent residenceof the foreign country before the applicant’s birth, the applicant shall not have Chinese citizenship.If anapplicant wants to apply as an international student, the applicant must have held 4a valid foreign passport or certificate of nationality before May 1, 2021. In addition, the applicant must have lived outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for at least twoyears during the period between May 1, 2021and April 30, 2025(subject to the entry and exit record, if the applicant has stayed outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for nine months or longer period during one year, it is equivalent to one year).Emigrants from Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan applying as international students must have held a valid foreign passport or certificate of nationality before May 1, 2021. In addition, the applicant must have lived outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for at least two years during the period between May 1, 2021and April 30, 2025(subject to the entry and exit record, if the applicant has stayed outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for nine months or longer period during one year, it is equivalent to one year).★Please pay special attention to Article 8 of the ‘Application Procedure’and prepare the required documents in advance.★Ifbothof the applicant’sparents were foreign nationals at the time of the applicant’s birth, Article 2 above does not apply
